title: Real GBA game built with GPT-6 Astra
author: HugoDzz
selftext: Made a Game Boy Advance ROM with GPT-6 Astra this weekend. I’ve documented the process and all my prompts [here](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/making-a-game-boy-advance-game-with-gpt-6-astra). Very impressed by Astra so far!

comments.author: OldLead4716
comments.body:
This is exciting  to see. I already had a wild idea about how my games nothing special but wouldn't it be cool to play it on a ds and then I thought about current games industry. 

I wonder if we're about to be at the cusp of a home brewers who sell those games not via download but ship out cartrages . 

My main project is a guitar effects modler I've been working on for a few years and timid about releasing it because everyone will just scream ai slop but I thought it would be cool to share via burt cds and mailing .

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body:
Actually a new golden age of cartrages shipped in well-crafted packages would be insanely cool.

On your game, just ship it, feedback is better than no feedback. If it can help, I've made a write-up about how I did this one [here](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/making-a-game-boy-advance-game-with-gpt-6-astra).

comments.author: vanderjud
comments.body:
This is awesome. I started working on my first game (in Godot) using Claude just before Astra was announced, so I have some fomo. How does something like this impact your usage credits? Like is it doable on a standard $20/mo Plus plan, or do you need one of the $100/mo plan?

I’m on the $20/mo Claude Pro plan and am burning through my weekly usage allotment after 2-3 days. Hitting my 5 hour session limit in an hour or 2. Kind of regretting my decision to go with Claude seeing all these recent productions using Astra.

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body:
Thanks ! No engine was used here, it’s plain C straight! About credits usage, it’s hard to tell as a use Astra for a lot of things, but it’d have fit in the $20 plan without problems I think.

It’s not a super long agent run or else, just a few back and forth!
